messages:
Maya: quick note — our replayed traffic shows a surprising drop in cross-request KV reuse when session ids are embedded in keys, esp for short prefixes. 12% lower reuse on chat-turn-heavy routes :thinking_face:
Alex: logged that. what's the current key shape?
Ritesh: we use `tenant|session|prefix_hash` for most routes, safe but fragmenting reuse across sessions.
Sam: curious — which routes suffer most?
Maya: message-generation and rerank endpoints. long ctx + frequent short prefixes. dropping session improved reuse on those by ~18% in the canary run.
Alex: hmm, but session gives isolation for private prompts. can't just remove it globally.
Ritesh: propose: make session component opt-in at route-level and default to `tenant|prefix_hash` for public/low-sensitivity routes. add `sticky=true` to keep previous behavior when needed.
Maya: perf profile attached in the PR shows latency stable and token cost down. also memory growth over long contexts decreased slightly because we avoid duplicate KV pages for same prefixes.
Sam: any fragmentation mitigation suggestions besides removing session?
Maya: yes — 1) canonicalize prefix (lowercase, strip non-deterministic tokens), 2) TTL bucketing (align expiries to buckets: 5m, 30m, 2h) to avoid micro-ttl churn, 3) keep a small global hotset for top prefixes to reduce page churn.
Alex: can you paste the canonicalization snippet?
Maya: sure:
```
def canonical_prefix(p):
    p = p.strip().lower()
    p = re.sub(r"\\s+", " ", p)
    p = NONCE_RE.sub("", p)  # strip user-generated nonces
    return p[:256]  # cap len
```
Ritesh: also thinking about key aliasing: map multiple semantically-equal prefixes to the same alias id via a small LRU map so we don't change existing persisted key schema. that keeps evictions contiguous.
Sam: ops requirements: if we change key shape we need a canary and rollback plan for miss-rate spikes. add a metric for `kv_alias_miss_rate`.
ops-bot: deploy-canary started: job/id=canary-prefix-aliasing, rollout=10% -> 50% over 2h. :rocket:
Maya: I'll upload the replay harness and test cases. plan: run 24h replay mirroring production distribution + A/B with 10% canary.
Alex: add a smoke check: hist of per-prefix residency, fragmentation index, and cross-request reuse pct. if reuse drops >2% revert.
Ritesh: for storage layer we should also consider grouping keys by alias bucket to reduce page splitting on eviction. small change but could help big workloads.
Maya: action items: open PR w/ key opt-in config, add canonicalizer, TTL buckets, replay harness + dashboard. will tag @Sam for rollout/runbook and @Alex for storage impact review. :thumbsup:
Sam: sgtm. please include a clear rollback command.
Maya: will do, thanks all :)
